not_supported: SpO2 is declining. -- 0 of 23 SpO2 values in the 24 h before the decision were low.

Oxygen requirement is increased. -- The oxygen flow rate decreased from 4 L/min to 2 L/min at 12:18 and remained at 2 L/min, while SpO2 declined to 91-94% in the hours before the decision time. The records do not show an increased oxygen requirement; instead, the requirement was reduced.

Fever is present. -- Median temperature over the 6 h before the decision: 99.9 F (1 readings), normal by the rule 'fever > 38.0 C (100.4 F); hypothermia < 36.0 C (96.8 F); Celsius rows are converted to F'.
